dct_title_s: Dewey Lake SE Quadrangle, Minnesota - St. Louis County, 1955: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Dewey Lake quadrangle topographic map (N4730-W9245/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in red ink and pencil regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the Dewey Lake area. The hand written notations include information on the following: logging camps noted with 'C'.
